hooks.command: [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open('/tmp/ganglion-'+('$GANGLION_TAB_ID')+'-tool','w').write(d.get('tool_name',''))" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && printf working > "/tmp/ganglion-$GANGLION_TAB_ID-status"; exit 0

[ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && printf idle > "/tmp/ganglion-$GANGLION_TAB_ID-status"; [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && printf "" > "/tmp/ganglion-$GANGLION_TAB_ID-tool" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && [ -z "$GANGLION_DISTILL" ] && python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open('/tmp/ganglion-'+os.environ['GANGLION_TAB_ID']+'-ingest','w').write(json.dumps({'session_id':d.get('session_id'),'transcript_path':d.get('transcript_path'),'cwd':d.get('cwd'),'event':d.get('hook_event_name','Stop')}))" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

[ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && printf idle > "/tmp/ganglion-$GANGLION_TAB_ID-status"; [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && printf "" > "/tmp/ganglion-$GANGLION_TAB_ID-tool" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$GANGLION_TAB_ID" ] && [ -z "$GANGLION_DISTILL" ] && python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open('/tmp/ganglion-'+os.environ['GANGLION_TAB_ID']+'-ingest','w').write(json.dumps({'session_id':d.get('session_id'),'transcript_path':d.get('transcript_path'),'cwd':d.get('cwd'),'event':d.get('hook_event_name','SessionEnd')}))" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
